'''''Soda''''' was an [[Painting/Legends|advertisement]] for the beverage of the same name, which was put up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It featured the word "[[Soda/Legends|SODA]]" written in [[Aurebesh]], vertically down a multi-[[Color/Legends|colored]] background. It was featured on both giant billboards such as the one that [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] ran across when the latter chased Cryar through the [[City/Legends|city]] planet, and smaller billboards in the city streets.<ref name="Lost" />
